Gender roles in childhood | Gender roles are the social and behavioral norms considered appropriate in social situations for people of different genders. Many young children have a firm sense of their gender identity, while some children can experience gender identity confusion.  In addition to biological maturation, children develop within a set of gender-specific social and behavioral norms embedded in family structure, natural play patterns, close friendships, and the teeming social jungle of school life.
